task.description: Gate ELIXIR-DEV's implementation (commit bd6bddf5, three docs files) for decision-record consistency and scope discipline -- your normal hard-gate role, per core-directives.md's producer/validator table. This is a docs-only change with no code, no migration, no supervision-tree file, so idiomatic-OTP concerns don't apply here; your check is specifically: (1) does the new ORCHESTRATOR.md sec.10 paragraph and the new GIT_MERGE.md Precondition paragraph actually say what the approved design specified, verbatim -- diff them against lib/letflow/design/iss-0467-direct-push-prohibition.md's Sections 2 and 3 yourself; (2) does the new 0018 subsection correctly represent the decision made (Option 2, not Option 1) without contradicting anything else already in 0018, including its existing Decision section ((a)-(d)) and its own 'A real gap found live' section that this subsection follows -- read 0018 in full, not just the diff, to confirm internal consistency; (3) is there any scope creep -- confirm git diff main...HEAD touches only the three named files (plus handoffs/); (4) does this correctly NOT re-open or contradict 0018's own already-decided Decision section (a)-(d) -- it should only add a follow-up resolution, never alter the original decision.
acceptance_criteria: GIT_MERGE.md's new paragraph confirmed to match the approved design's Section 2 text verbatim (diff or direct comparison)
ORCHESTRATOR.md's new paragraph confirmed to match the approved design's Section 3 text verbatim
0018's new subsection is internally consistent with the rest of 0018 -- no contradiction with the existing Decision (a)-(d) section, and correctly framed as a follow-up resolution, not a re-opening
git diff main...HEAD confirmed to touch only the three named docs files plus handoffs/ -- no scope creep
No lib/priv/web/ files touched (sanity confirmation this is genuinely docs-only)

result.summary: Docs-only scope confirmed: `git diff main...HEAD --stat` and `git show bd6bddf5 --stat` touch only docs/agents/ORCHESTRATOR.md, docs/agents/protocols/GIT_MERGE.md, docs/migration/decisions/0018-branch-protection-posture.md, plus handoffs/ and lib/letflow/design/iss-0467-direct-push-prohibition.md (design artefact, not code) -- no lib/, priv/, or web/ files touched anywhere in the run's commit range. (1) GIT_MERGE.md's inserted blockquote (git show bd6bddf5, +20 lines after the Precondition paragraph ending '...not only the meaning of green the agent chooses to trust.') was compared word-for-word against design Section 2's 'Verbatim text to add' block: identical, including the parenthetical dating and the misread-protocol closing sentence. Placement matches the design's specified location (inside Precondition, before the 'What reported green means here' paragraph). (2) ORCHESTRATOR.md's inserted blockquote (+13 lines, appended at the end of section 10 after '...When a check is ambiguous, it is a no.') was compared word-for-word against design Section 3's verbatim block: identical. (3) Read docs/migration/decisions/0018-branch-protection-posture.md in full (516 lines, not just the diff). The new 'ISS-0467 resolution: direct-push prohibition (2026-09-05)' subsection is placed exactly where the design specified (after 'A real gap found live', before 'What this record does not decide'). It reaffirms rather than contradicts Decision (a) ('restricting who can push would have no effect here... would only add a maintenance surface' -- the new subsection's own reasoning for rejecting Option 1 restates this verbatim rationale with fresh live evidence); it does not touch or restate (b)/(c)/(d) (enforce_admins/override mechanics), which are orthogonal to this fix. It explicitly frames itself as completing the 'Follow-up, not re-opening this decision' section already present in 0018 ('ISS-0467 (filed to resolve the follow-up named above) is now designed and applied'), and does not alter the Decision section, Configuration-to-apply commands, or Verification log anywhere. No internal contradiction found. Scope discipline: no abstractions, behaviours, or generic plumbing introduced -- this is a documentation prohibition plus a decision-record subsection, matching exactly what the design specified and nothing more (Option 1's gh api/ruleset config was explicitly not added, per design Section 6, and the diff confirms no such call appears anywhere). No OTP/supervision concerns apply (no code touched). No type-safety-gap or scope-creep issues to file.
